rules.applies_when: action changes files, Git, devices, EDA, production or external systems
actions: match action and target to authorization
acceptance: read-only actions need no mutation authority
every side effect is within exact authorized scope
invalid or absent authority is denied
rules.failure_policy: block only the affected action and continue independent read-only work

actions: resolve root and target without shell expansion
reject traversal links and broad roots
check dirty overlap and exact object list
acceptance: target is a descendant of authorized root
target is not home drive root or workspace root for recursive destructive action
rules.failure_policy: do not write; report exact unsafe target and preserved state

rules.applies_when: any task establishes or restores a baseline
acceptance: every locked input has path version and SHA-256
no project-specific fact becomes a global default
rules.failure_policy: enter NEEDS_REVIEW for changed or conflicting inputs

rules.applies_when: a result is promoted to PASS or COMPLETED
actions: verify tool target exit code and declared outputs
acceptance: PASS has at least one matching current artifact
tool verification has exit code zero and every declared output
COMPLETED has all required checks evidence-valid
rules.failure_policy: reject promotion and retain FAIL BLOCKED or NOT_RUN

acceptance: completed side effect is not replayed
uncertain flash delete overwrite commit or production action becomes NEEDS_REVIEW
rules.failure_policy: stop affected branch and expose safe next action

rules.applies_when: resource consumption can grow with input
acceptance: no unbounded scan log retry or task
limit termination is not reported as complete coverage
rules.failure_policy: return PARTIAL or BLOCKED with measured coverage
